summary: Full first-pass E2E test of ClientRevive AI. Backend: 35 pytest cases across auth/register+seed, clients CRUD, orders CRUD, follow-ups, dashboard summary, settings, AI (generate-message + shorter modifier, analyze, recommendations), auth enforcement and multi-tenant data isolation - all 35 PASSED (100%). Frontend: login with demo@clientrevive.ai, all 8 dashboard stat cards, revenue banner, 8 today's follow-up cards, all 8 sidebar nav routes, Clients page (7 filters + search + Tambah Klien dialog), Client profile (AI analysis w/ score ring 42, layanan/tawaran/timing, order history), AI message generator (325-char Indonesian message, Persingkat produced 235 chars, Salin copies, Kirim WhatsApp opens wa.me with prefilled text and records follow-up which appears in Riwayat Follow-Up + Tindak Lanjut page), Rekomendasi AI (10 ranked clients + 3 KPIs), Settings load/save/persist, Orders, Kalender, Analitik charts, logout. No blocking defects found.

minor.issue: Stale 500s found in backend.err.log (TypeError: '>=' not supported between NoneType and int at old server.py:457 in dashboard_summary). Tracebacks predate the last server.py hot-reload and are NOT reproducible on the current code (days=None is now guarded). Flagged for awareness only.
recommended_offer prices use US thousand separators: f"Rp {price:,.0f}" -> 'Rp 500,000'. Rest of app (formatIDR) renders 'Rp 500.000'. Inconsistent currency formatting in an id-ID UI.
Sets client.follow_up_status = 'Contacted' (English) while ClientIn default and UI filters use Bahasa values ('Belum Dihubungi'). Value never matches any UI filter.

Clients with zero orders are counted as dormant (days=9999) in dashboard_summary but /clients returns days_since_last_order=null, and Clients page filters treat null as 0 -> dormant_30 (16) does not match the 30+ filter list (14). Inconsistent dormancy definition.

ui_bugs.issue: await navigator.clipboard.writeText() has no try/catch. When clipboard permission is denied the unhandled rejection triggers the webpack-dev-server error overlay iframe, which then intercepts pointer events and blocks every subsequent click on the page (reproduced: Kirim WhatsApp and sidebar nav clicks timed out). Needs try/catch + fallback + toast.error.
shadcn Calendar month/weekday labels are English ('August 2026', 'Su Mo Tu') in an otherwise fully Bahasa Indonesia UI. Pass locale={id} from date-fns.
Recharts console warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on mount (ResponsiveContainer in a zero-width container during route transition). Cosmetic but noisy.

integration_issues.issue: First generate attempt returned empty after 16s while the /ai/analyze call was still in flight; the AI call can take 15-25s. Second run succeeded (325 chars). Consider showing a skeleton/progress and a client-side timeout+retry so the user does not see an empty textarea.

issues: No issues found: contrast, spacing, card grid, footer and terracotta CTA all render correctly at 1920x1080
Offer prices show 'Rp 500,000' (comma) vs 'Rp 1.967.633' (dot) on the same screen - visually inconsistent

action_items: Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch in ClientProfile.copyMsg (prevents dev-overlay from blocking all clicks)
Use dot thousand separators for recommended_offer prices in /api/ai/recommendations (match formatIDR)
Use Bahasa value (e.g. 'Sudah Dihubungi') instead of 'Contacted' in POST /api/followups client update
Align dormancy definition for zero-order clients between /dashboard/summary (9999) and Clients page filters (null->0)
Set date-fns id locale on the Kalender shadcn Calendar
Optional: split /app/backend/server.py (917 lines) into routers (auth, clients, orders, ai, settings)
critical_code_review_comments: ClientProfile.copyMsg lacks error handling on an async Web API - the only real click-blocking defect found
server.py is 917 lines; AI prompts, seed data and routes should be modularised

compute_opportunity_score / days_between logic duplicated across list_clients, get_client, dashboard_summary and ai_recommendations (4 copies of the same enrichment block) - extract a shared enrich_client() helper
ai_analyze silently falls back to a hardcoded Indonesian recommendation on JSON parse failure; consider returning a flag so UI can indicate the analysis is generic

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; clipboard error-handling defect + 2 i18n/cosmetic issues)

seed_data_creation: Registered throwaway users TEST_<hex>@clientrevivetest.com (auto-seeded 15 clients) for isolation/seed tests; created and deleted TEST_ clients/orders/follow-ups under the demo user. One leftover UI-created client 'QA Playwright Klien' and one follow-up record for Sarah Wijaya remain under demo@clientrevive.ai (demo client count is now 17, not 15).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v). Note: register requires a real TLD - '.test' domains are rejected by EmailStr, use @clientrevivetest.com. Demo user now has 17 clients and 1 follow-up, so hardcoding total_clients==15 for the demo account will fail; use a freshly registered user for seed-count assertions (fresh_user fixture). Frontend testids verified: stat-total-klien, stat-dormant-30+, stat-klien-vip/high, client-card-{id}, filter-{all|30|60|90|vip|hot|never}, rec-{id}, btn-generate, btn-copy, btn-whatsapp, nav-*. Grant clipboard permissions before clicking btn-copy or the webpack dev overlay will block subsequent clicks.
rca_of_the_issue: Click-blocking RCA: clicking Salin without clipboard permission rejects navigator.clipboard.writeText; because copyMsg does not catch it, CRA's webpack-dev-server injects an error overlay iframe (#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) over the viewport, which intercepts pointer events and makes every later click (Kirim WhatsApp, sidebar nav) time out. Fix = try/catch + toast fallback in ClientProfile.copyMsg.
